title: “Good stay but disappointing damage ”
review_text:
For my 40th birthday, I had decided to splurge extra and treat myself so I booked myself a villa at Amara Resort, certainly not a cheap deal but something i did because at the time of booking, travelling out wasnt an option. 

A few of my friends with their kids came over to celebrate with me and over the course of the day, I discovered that the kids were getting cuts on their feet because of something in the pool. I decided to raise this with the management after my stay via email. 
The rest of the stay was pleasant and the service staff was very prompt and courteous with their service. 

Following my stay, I emailed the management of the resort to report what had happened, with pics of the cuts  and included the parents of the concerned kids in the email for full transparency. My request was simple: please investigate what happened, please share with me what you found, and offer some sort of compensation I can share with the parents. 

What followed was a series of 7-8 emails and without going into the details, of what turned out to be a frustrating experience just trying to get basic answers, the resort was still not able to articulate what they found and how they fixed it. As 'compensation', they would offer me a 50% discount on the next stay at he VILLA- which meant I would have to fork out a large amount of money again to avail a 50% discount!!! 

In summary, the responses I received from the management were far from professional, there was no accountability or transparency of what their investigation entailed and lastly, in any service industry, when you and your services are responsible for causing distress to the customer - you don't ask them to spend more money to avail of a compensation. It should be provided at the first instance to ensure customer loyalty and turning that opportunity into a win for both the customer and the service provider. The resort fell short on both accounts and if you are trying to reach them at the reception (via phone) - good lu

This is my 2nd time in Singapore, and luckily I have found the best hotel that suits my budget, my needs(Bidet is a must) and is near to all!

Strategically located in Lavender, it is near the MRT Station of Lavender which is just few mins away from the airport and connected to all lines. It is also near the bus station which is few stops from Bugis and Chinatown. It is near cafes, eateries, restaurants and fast food chains. Grocery store is just in front of the hotel. It really made our travel around the city easy breezy as 123.

Checking in was so easy even if we arrived late.  There’s a security deposit of 50$ using card. They do not accept cash. The staff are so helpful and accomodating.

The room itself is so clean and well maintained. Everyday the houskeeping would clean our room which is nice.

Saved us some bucks from buying drinking water outside. They have a water dispenser in each floor, just provide your tumblers and bottles. 

The corridor smells so good! 

10/10 stay for this hotel! Would definitely book again when we come back hopefully in 2025. 

Thank you Beverly Elements Hotel! 😊

title: “Very disappointed with the overall experience ”
review_text:
I stayed at Amara Sanctuary Resort from 8–9 November 2025 and was disappointed with several aspects of my experience.

First, the service from both the shuttle bus driver and the restaurant staff fell far below expectations. The shuttle driver was rude, unhelpful, and dismissive. When we politely asked if the bus was heading to Resorts World Sentosa, he responded with an angry expression

The service at the resort’s restaurant was also poor. The staff were inattentive, lacked courtesy, and did not provide the level of service expected from a hotel of this calibre.

Additionally, I had pre-arranged a birthday surprise for my friend — including a cake and room decorations — which the hotel had confirmed beforehand. However, none of these were prepared upon our arrival, which was extremely disappointing for what was meant to be a special celebration.

I also emailed the hotel regarding this experience, and while the staff replied that they would investigate, I have not received any follow-up or response even after one week. This lack of accountability further added to the disappointment.

Overall, the stay did not meet the standards I expected, and I hope the hotel improves its service, communication, and reliability moving forward.

title: “Comfortable ”

We stayed in a family suite, which was nicely decorated, comfortable, and fully functional — everything worked as it should. The beds were comfortable, and the rooms were clean.

The buffet breakfast was fairly standard, offering a mix of Indian, Chinese, and Western dishes.

Singapore is an expensive city to visit, so keep in mind that value and expectations don’t always align. That said, the M Hotel offered reasonable quality, though I personally felt it was slightly overpriced.

Would definitely not recommend this resort. A few negative experiences: 
1. When arrived, there was no staff present to help with the luggages etc even though there was staff available at the reception and they clearly saw me struggling with my belongings, they didn’t do anything. 
2. The place is very run down and definitely doesn’t look like it’s worth that amount of money paid to stay there
3. The uncarpeted area of the room is very dirty with stains around. For the first time it wasn’t a choice whether or not to wear the hotel slippers for me. 
4. There is no room service after 9/930PM. It is very inconvenient for the occupants when we need help. Honestly that timing is too early for anyone. 
5. The “sky pool” is overrated by the hotel. It is actually quite a small pool and the view isn’t as expected. 
6. The security guard and the buggy drivers were very rude when we overheard them discussing about planning to do door to door inspection for guests. Are they really going to knock on each door and disturb our stay there? 
7. To get ice, you’ve to bring the ice bucket down to the restaurant and get it yourself. Honestly I don’t know what kind of service have they provided us with other than checking us in and the daily room cleaning service. 

If I have known, I would not have mind paying slightly more for W hotel or Sofitel which gave me a better experience during my previous stay there.

Some areas for improvement 
1. Bed was a little dusty when we stayed. Not sure why. 
2. Room AC not cold enough during the heatwave (it was 34 to 35°C on that day)
3. In room dining. This was a little unpleasant as we had a long day out and decide to settle down and have our late dinner back in the room. We placed our order at around 10:50PM but the food came only at 12:10 AM. You know the saying - a hungry men is an angry men and I was edgy while waiting for the food. But nonetheless food was good and I guess it was late at night and the kitchen was probably closed which explains why it took longer. But it'd be good if the staff could keep us updated instead of having to call 4 times to check on the order. 

Overall I'd still recommend this place. It was my first time and I'd probably go back when I visit again.

title: “Thank you Manager Abel”
review_text:
There was a small hiccup during my transition of room changing from Day 1 of stay . Was promised a Room A to Room B no waiting transition but was faced otherwise upon check out from Day 1 .  Was furious. If  I have not been told the arrangement above could be done ( no waiting transition) probably would not have made arrangements to work around with plans. Plans made, much to my horror , was told upon check out need to wait till 3pm before I can be checked into my new room. (Timestamp:1210 noon )And was brushed away with.. "sorry as you know it's the holiday season , we are fully booked . ... the housekeeping has not cleaned the room..... they got many rooms to clean up .... please come back at 3 pm" 
I saw no efforts made to check with house keeping or with her manager. AND I SERIOUSLY FEEL "THEY GOT MANY ROOMS TO CLEAN UP" was very uncalled for to be told . 
I went up to my vehicle and called furiously to their phone lines which also took quite a while to be even answered .  I tried all extensions too.

But fortunately,  Manager Abel made it all better . He apologized for the hiccup . He went to see what necessary arrangements could be done and called me back as and when throughout to update me with follow ups.  He manage to get me a room around  1 30pm .
But I went around to reschedule my plans and decide to pick my kids n helper up from mainland first .
Arrived.  The check in was fast and smooth. The counter staff told me my room is ready and ushered me room keys upon immediate .. 
I am thankful and appreciate that Manager Abel has been a wonderful help , customer service is very professional.  The 2 stars for him . 2 for the overall hotel , room satisfaction, -1 for counter check in experience.

title: “Wonderful stay that exceeded our expectations”
review_text:
We were glad that we made it for the staycation. 

We love the interior architecture that really resembles a garden in a hotel. There were even birds chirping inside the hotel when we were having breakfast on level 4. They have a large and well-equipped gym room and pool. The pool looks gorgeous at night. We like our urban deluxe room that has a walk out balcony with the city view of Esplanade, National Gallery, and a glimpse of the Merlion at Marina Bay. It is indeed a 5-star hotel with good services, friendly and efficient staff. We went to celebrate our anniversary and received many surprises which we really appreciated it. The room design is comfy and modern, just a downside that the toilet design is a little old-fashioned with a traditional bidet toilet bowl which is quite unnecessary if they have upgraded their toilet bowls. And it could have been better if the filtered drinking water tap is outside the toilet instead of inside it. Plus, the toilet bowl shouldn't be so close to the low bath tub. 

Putting aside the toilet design, everything else was great. We plan to stay here again in the near future.

チャンギ空港にも、中心部にも行きやすいです。

title: “Good budget hotel in convenient location”
review_text:
Beverley Hotels Elements is a good budget hotel located conveniently near the Lavender MRT  station (MRT= Singapore's subway/metro) which is on the green line that comes from the airport.  It is not far from Little India, Kampong Glam, Geyalng. East Coast Beach, Marina Bay and Singapore City centre.

The staff were helpful and allowed us to store our luggage for a few hours at the hotel after we arrived from the airport early in the morning, before the check in time of 2pm, and after checkout (checkout time is by 12pm) before it was time for us to go to the airport.

The twin room was clean but very small, barely big enough for 2 beds, but that is ok for just a couple of days stay.  The room had an en suite shower/toilet and sink and a small fridge.  The tap water is safe to drink from the tap.

The hotel does not serve breakfast but there are a lot of eating places nearby such as restaurants in shopping centre, food courts, an Indian Muslim restaurant, a coffee shop with a vegetarian stall.  There is a supermarket across the road from the hotel that opens from 7am to 11pm.
